name: 993 dashboard switch blank (PicoGK)
material_candidate: polymer, grade to be determined after fit test (FFF / SLA / MJF candidates; PA12 density used for the mass estimate)
picogk_enhancement: Pillow-crowned face with rolled edges, hollow through-body open at the back and two cantilever snap tongues with lead-in barbs cut out of the walls - one body, no assembly, slot clearances held in voxels. Replaces the flat plate with two bare tabs.

face_width_mm.note: F0 hypothesis: declared opening ~19 mm + 1 mm overlap per side

face_height_mm.note: F0 hypothesis: declared opening ~31 mm + 1 mm overlap per side

tab_length_mm.note: F0 tab length hypothesis, used as body depth behind the face

tab_thickness_mm.note: F0 tab thickness hypothesis, used as body wall and tongue thickness

opening_width_mm.note: SRC-RENNLIST-993-DASHBOARD-LIGHTING-DIMENSIONS, owner estimate ~19 x 31 mm, level C, no instrument

body_clearance_mm.note: radial clearance body to opening, per side

face_crown_mm.note: pillow crown of the visible face

clip_slot_mm.note: slit width either side of a tongue

clip_slot_length_mm.note: free tongue length from the back

panel_thickness_mm.note: dashboard panel thickness at the opening, not measured

open_interfaces: real opening size (owner estimate only) and panel thickness
clip/latch geometry of the OEM blank
face size, edge profile and body depth (no measurement record yet)
Porsche part number and model-year variant
status: F0 concept geometry - not fitted, not tested, not safe, not released, not a print file
